title: The Distant village in the hills
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：distant　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 distant 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the herder wrote of ① a distant village in the hills in the ledger, and everybody in the pasture said at once that it was ② more distant than the one named there the year before. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the herder, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the distant ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most distant village in the hills anybody in the pasture had ever seen, or so the ledger for December 1967 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too distant to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the distant ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a distant cousin on the coast, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as distant as the cousin on the coast they had once had in the old pasture. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was distant or not, and he said so.

By 1980 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something distant, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next pasture called the whole plan ⑧ quite distant; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the distant ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1983, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another distant village in the hills in the same ledger, and the work, which took two winters, seemed ⑨ more distant than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most distant cousin on the coast in the whole pasture, she said in 1985, was the one she could never quite name; the distant ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 遥远（前置定语 a distant village in the hills：1973 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的那件遥远的村子）
B. adj. 遥远／疏远（比较级 more distant than：文中两处，一处比山里的村子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 遥远／疏远（最高级 the most distant：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 遥远（表语 too distant to do：母亲觉得它太遥远，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 疏远（前置定语 a distant cousin on the coast：叔叔把整件事称作一桩疏远的远亲）
F. adj. 疏远（同级比较 as distant as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩海边的远亲相比）
G. adj. 疏远（后置定语 something distant：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 疏远（受程度副词修饰 quite distant：那位邻人的评价）

items.q: a distant village in the hills
the most distant village in the hills anybody
a distant cousin on the coast
The most distant cousin on the coast in

answers.why: distant 意为“遥远”，1973 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的是“一件遥远的村子”，此处作前置定语 a distant village in the hills。
distant 意为“遥远”，此处用比较级 more distant than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
distant 意为“遥远”，牧群台账上 十二月 那行字说它是牧场里最遥远的一件，故用最高级 the most distant village in the hills。
distant 意为“遥远”，母亲认为这件东西“太遥远了，谁也用不上”，too distant to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
distant 意为“疏远”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩疏远的远亲”，此处作前置定语 a distant cousin on the coast。
distant 意为“疏远”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩海边的远亲一样疏远”，同级比较用 as distant as。
distant 意为“疏远”，牧群台账上那半行字要的是“疏远的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something distant。
distant 意为“疏远”，邻牧场来的那位邻人认为这套计划“相当疏远”，quite 修饰原级 distant。
distant 意为“疏远”，1983 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要疏远”，故用比较级 more distant than。
distant 意为“疏远”，母亲 1985 年说的是“整个牧场里最疏远的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most distant cousin on the coast。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，牧人在牧群台账里记下了一件遥远的村子。（a distant village in the hills）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更遥远。（more distant than …）
母亲觉得它太遥远，谁也用不上。（too distant to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩疏远的远亲。（a distant cousin on the coast）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩海边的远亲一样疏远。（as distant as …）
到了 1980 年，牧群台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件疏远的东西。（something distant）
answers: In 1973 the herder wrote of a distant village in the hills in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more distant than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too distant to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a distant cousin on the coast.
He said nobody would call it as distant as the cousin on the coast they had once had.
By 1980 the ledger asked for nothing but something distant.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 distant 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the herder wrote of a distant village in the hills in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most distant village in the hills in the pasture, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too distant to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a distant cousin on the coast, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next pasture called the plan quite distant, and everybody laughed.
The distant ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
